WITH totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(traitcount::NUMERIC) as overall_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) as distinct_sites
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
),
site_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    SUM(traitcount::NUMERIC) as feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    s.feature_count,
    s.feature_count / t.overall_total as share,
    (s.feature_count / t.overall_total) - (1.0 / t.distinct_sites) as margin,
    1.0 / t.distinct_sites as avg_share
  FROM site_totals s, totals t
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  feature_count,
  share,
  margin
FROM with_shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10
